'''Cecilia Arens''' is the [[Wisdom]] of [[Aturo's Orchard]].
== History ==
Cecilia lives in a small home in a grove to the west of the [[Three Crowns Inn]]. She has been the Wisdom for nearly fifty years, and is loved and respected by all in the village. 

She is a [[wilder]] of great age. She is blind in one eye, and walks with a cane.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
